questions.q: The values of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>λ</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>μ</mi></math> such that the system of equations <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>26</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>λ</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>μ</mi></math> has no solution, are:

And, the system has no solution, if D=0 and atleast one of Dx, Dy & Dz is non-zero.

Thus, for the given system of equations,

⇒15μ-52-13μ-26+66-5≠0

⇒5μ-52-3μ+26+6≠0

⇒2μ≠20

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution:
x-4y+7z=g ...(i)

3y-5z=h ...(ii)

-2x+5y-9z=k ...(iii)

(i) + (ii), we get

x-y+2z=g+h ...(iv)

(ii) - (iii), we get

2x-2y+4z=h-k

⇒   x-y+2z=h-k2 ...(v)

Since, coefficient of x,y,z in (iv) and (v) are same. Hence, for system to be consistent

g+h=h-k2

⇒   2g+2h=h-k

⇒   2g+h+k=0
